technical.title: EvalForge
technical.label: AI Agent Evaluation & Reliability
technical.summary: AI agent evaluation platform comparing task completion, tool accuracy, latency percentiles, cost, and safety.
technical.detail: EvalForge automates multi-turn AI agent evaluation across ReAct, planning, reflection, retrieval, and model-routing strategies. It captures structured traces, supports deterministic replay, clusters failures, and detects regressions across token overhead and latency.

technical.title: WarehouseGraph
technical.label: Operations Exception Intelligence
technical.summary: AI operations platform investigating discrepancies across RFID, inventory, order, shipment, and receiving events.
technical.detail: Reconstructs end-to-end product timelines across fragmented operational data. Pairs statistical anomaly detection with agent-driven root-cause reports and Power BI dashboards tracking fulfillment accuracy and cycle time.

technical.title: IncidentTwin
technical.label: Autonomous AI Incident Commander
technical.summary: Agentic incident-response system diagnosing application, database, network, and infrastructure failures.
technical.detail: Integrates tools for querying logs, metrics, DNS, deployment history, and service health into iterative hypothesis, diagnosis, remediation, and verification workflows—with explicit human approval gates, OpenTelemetry tracing, and rollback controls.

technical.title: TraceIQ
technical.label: Requirements & Change-Impact
technical.summary: Traceability platform linking business rules, database fields, REST APIs, reports, and test cases.
technical.detail: TraceIQ maps downstream dependencies across data sources, integrations, and KPIs before implementation. Uses SQL-based validation and API inspection to verify expected business rules and generate UAT checklists.

campaigns.title: PANIC BUTTON®
campaigns.label: Product Launch & Strategy
campaigns.summary: Last-Minute Academic Survival OS for students who become academic weapons at 11:48 PM.
campaigns.detail: A high-converting product launch landing page and marketing campaign built with Swiss Editorial Brutalism. Features an interactive 'How Cooked Are You?' diagnostic slider, dynamic thermal survival receipt, Web Audio synthesizer, app jail lockdown simulator, and emergency cockpit sprint timer.

campaigns.title: TOUCH GRASS™
campaigns.label: Digital Advertising Campaign
campaigns.summary: Anti-advertising digital wellness campaign across Meta Feed, Stories, Display, and YouTube Pre-Roll.
campaigns.detail: An omnichannel paid digital advertising campaign and portfolio case study engineered in Frutiger Aero and Pentagram editorial aesthetics. Hijacks familiar operating system alerts and SaaS pricing parodies into playful, thumb-stopping prompts for students to close the tab and step outside.

campaigns.title: FRIDGE FRIEND
campaigns.label: Consumer App Launch
campaigns.summary: Your fridge has seen enough. A smart kitchen companion tackling grocery waste and condiment hoarding.
campaigns.detail: Product launch landing page designed in an Indie Culinary Zine and Risograph aesthetic. Showcases a physical 3D enamel fridge door with clacking alphabet magnets, an interactive Produce Graveyard triage board, an in-store Duplicate Blocker with ink-stamp physics, and a Chaos Chef leftover alchemy engine.

campaigns.title: DON’T TAKE THE BAIT.
campaigns.label: Cybersecurity Awareness
campaigns.summary: Dark-mode cyber-ops phishing awareness poster and educational campaign for university IT.
campaigns.detail: A high-impact enterprise cybersecurity poster designed in an Apple / Linear-grade dark cyber-intelligence system. Deconstructs the anatomy of credential-harvesting emails with optical metallic hook layering, interactive threat vector inspector, and zero-trust verification rules.

posters.title: MotoRental — Lubbock Rental Platform
posters.label: UI/UX Figma Prototype · Lubbock Market
posters.summary: High-fidelity interactive Figma prototype for MotoRental, designed to simplify vehicle rentals in the Lubbock market.
posters.detail: End-to-end user flow covering local Lubbock rental discovery, transparent pricing, availability filtering, and streamlined booking handoff.

posters.title: Poster 001 — Printer
posters.label: Campus IT Etiquette · 001
posters.summary: Hardware preservation and paper jam intervention signage for campus computer labs.
posters.detail: Part of the 'Please Do Not Feed the Printer' campus signage series pairing playful warning metaphors with clear troubleshooting cues to cut down lab maintenance tickets.

posters.title: Poster 002 — Wi-Fi
posters.label: Network & Connectivity · 002
posters.summary: Authentication diagnostics and eduroam connection cues designed to reduce helpdesk tickets.
posters.detail: Guides students through fast campus Wi-Fi onboarding and common certificate fixes using high-contrast, scannable typographic blocks.

posters.title: Poster 003 — Password Reset
posters.label: Identity & Access · 003
posters.summary: Clear credential recovery steps and 2FA self-service guidance for student portals.
posters.detail: Demystifies self-service password resets and multi-factor authentication recovery during peak exam-week lockouts.

posters.title: Poster 004 — Computer Lab
posters.label: Lab Environment · 004
posters.summary: Shared workstation hygiene, peripheral etiquette, and clean workspace standards.
posters.detail: Closes the 4-poster Campus IT series with friendly, memorable reminders on logging out, saving cloud work, and respecting shared lab gear.

posters.title: NIGHT SHIFT — Refined Night Letter
posters.label: Campus Culture & Study
posters.summary: Atmospheric editorial campaign framing the library after dark as a sanctuary for focused creators.
posters.detail: A moody, cinematic visual series capturing late-night university study culture and aligning 24-hour campus facility availability with student productivity cycles.

posters.title: HALF FULL
posters.label: Student Wellness Initiative
posters.summary: Gentle, non-preachy mental health and hydration nudges designed for student desk spaces.
posters.detail: An optimistic micro-campaign using conversational, warm design cues to counter mid-semester burnout across university common areas.

posters.title: NOIRTONE
posters.label: Monochrome Editorial Identity
posters.summary: Ultra-disciplined black-and-white typography and brand study inspired by classic Swiss Modernism.
posters.detail: An exploration of pure contrast, negative space, and typographic grid systems demonstrating how strict aesthetic constraints produce high-memorability communication.

posters.title: SAVE POINT
posters.label: Gamified Academic Progress
posters.summary: Retro RPG milestone tracker framing semester checkpoints as comforting gaming save-states.
posters.detail: A playful retention and habit-tracking concept translating overwhelming term deliverables into discrete, low-anxiety quest checkpoints.
